scope: Educational historical illustration with placeholder asset identities. Not financial advice. Historical numeric values are retained; original contracts and token-specific source URLs are omitted.
formula: Observed price change = (period high / assessment reference - 1) × 100

period.label: 6 Feb – 22 Sept 2025
period.note: Retrospectively selected case-study period, from the earliest captured launch day through two calendar days after this narrative-cycle high. This is a display window, not an assumed holding period or trade exit.

supply.label: FDV
supply.basis: Illustrative fully diluted value: recorded USD price multiplied by the archived total supply. Historical circulating supply is unverified.
supply.sourceNote: Total supply is retained only to reproduce the historical FDV illustration. Asset identity and token-specific source links are omitted.

peak.note: Recorded period high: the greatest observed post-decision daily high inside the selected display period. Its timestamp is the candle interval open; the exact trade time is unknown. The reference is a completed minute candle, not a fill. Endpoint ratios omit the intervening price path, fees, taxes, slippage and liquidity.

coverage.note: Native GMGN candles, without interpolation or aggregation. Leading UTC buckets before the first observed trading candle are absent.
